text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Prez! Guess what? Turns out today's
Father's
Day!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Sooo, you're gonna be my dad for the
day!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to be your dad? I can't even
begin to
imagine what you mean...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to! Look, if you were my
dad, how
would you raise me?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hm, how would I raise you... Well, I
wouldn't use
any specific methods, I
think.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I would raise you with love and watch
you grow.
The same way I treat any
other Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
True impartiality. I would treat my child
like any
other, so that they in turn treat
others equally.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wow, so you wouldn't pick favorites?
My dad
rocks!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Come now, I'm not your dad.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (The president's doing that for Teio...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (I could do that too, maybe.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Ryan. Today's Father's Day... So
you're my
dad, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What?! What do you mean,
"right?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You don't... want to be my dad?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
O-okay, okay. I'll be your dad. Ever
since we were
little, you've always come
up with these weird
games outta
nowhere...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So, if you were my dad, how would you
raise me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
How would I raise you? We'd play
soccer,
basketball, and catchball
together, I guess?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Only sports.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Well, I-I don't know what else to say... I
don't
have a clue how to be a dad.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
But I'd stick to it until you got bored,
then I'd do
my best to play whatever
other game you wanted!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That reminds me of when we were little,
you
would do just that whenever my
parents weren't
around.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Ryan. I guess.. you really are
my dad.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Nope. This dad thing is only for today,
got it?
